rationale: C09 is a direct and extensive drafting template for the child. The child preserves the same seven-section architecture, nearly verbatim language describing the labor controversy and commission's settlement objective, the hearing and party-protection provisions, inter-commission coordination, agency cooperation, emergency-fund financing, reporting and termination, and delayed-effectiveness machinery. It adapts that order to a different union, proposal, commission membership, and reporting deadline, and expressly links its reporting schedule to the commission established by the March 24, 1961 order. C21 is the next-strongest antecedent because it contains much of the same labor-commission language and administrative machinery, while C20 closely parallels the inquiry, findings, recommendations, and amicable-settlement provisions but lacks most of the child's later sections.
